# FatFs R0.16

Upstream: ChaN, <https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/>
Downloaded archive: <https://elm-chan.org/fsw/ff/arc/ff16.zip>
SHA-256: `99f7dc1f7e095356e4a9e3dbe29959090d8b948afe2bbc5441e52fdf4b85449e`

The upstream copyright, redistribution condition and disclaimer remain at the
start of `ff.c`, `ff.h`, and `ffunicode.c`. They permit source/binary redistribution
with those notices preserved. `diskio.h` is the upstream integration contract.

Local adaptations:

- Normalize CRLF to LF.
- `ff.h`: `EKITOS_FATFS_TYPES` selects the project's fixed-width C typedefs,
  avoiding duplicate incompatible `stdint.h` typedefs in the freestanding kernel.
- `ff.c`: use the project's `lib/string.h` instead of a hosted `string.h`.
- `ff.c`: initialize and retain a valid exFAT access timestamp. Upstream stores
  zero there, which exfat-utils 1.4.0 reports as `bad date 1980-00-00`. Creation,
  mkdir and sync now use the same configured timestamp as other file timestamps;
  directory-entry checksums are still generated by upstream `store_xdir`.
- `ffconf.h`: FAT12/16/32 + exFAT, UTF-8 long names, CP437 short names, 64-bit
  file offsets/LBAs and GPT, 512–4096-byte sectors, four volumes, tiny per-volume
  cache, heap LFN workspace, external VFS serialization, no RTC.
  Runtime formatting is disabled. `EKITOS_FATFS_FORMAT` enables it only in the
  host fixture test executable.

The VFS/disk adapters are in `fs/fat/`. They are project code, not upstream FatFs.
The kernel supplies one-page LFN workspaces through `page_alloc` and frees them
at the end of each operation. Timestamps use the configured fixed date 2025-01-01;
there is no claim that these represent real creation/access times.

Validation uses mtools to format FAT12/16/32 and, when built in `build/deps`,
relan/exfat-utils 1.4.0 to independently format and check exFAT. The latter is a
host test dependency only and is not linked into the kernel or driver modules.
